in_hebrew.name: Alverta
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Old man's strength
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Alverta הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Alpheios, meaning 'giver of strength'. In Greek mythology, Alpheios was a river god, often depicted as an old man. The name Alverta is a feminine variant and carries the symbolism of resilience and enduring strength.
